findings.fix: Decline inference for conditional introductions across blocks, including “when” and “in case”; add regression cases for both.
findings.issue: Conditional context across blocks escapes the veto: “When necessary:” followed by “Stacked on #12.” establishes a current parent despite being conditional.

findings.evidence:
The regex explicitly accepts '(?:and|or)'; direct execution of rendered_parents('

Depends on #12 or #13.

') returns {12, 13}. Lines 647–702 can then confirm either alternative using matching source content.
findings.fix: Reject disjunctive lists for body-only authority rather than adding both alternatives to the parent set.
findings.issue: The reference-list parser converts alternative dependencies into individually asserted parents: “Depends on #12 or #13.” does not establish dependency on either particular PR.

summary: The zero-content finding is resolved. Conditional context and disjunctive references still become affirmative parent identities, allowing independently matching content to support false closure.
